answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fakes. Each agent claims one slot by locking a 50 POA deposit. A slot lives only while its agent works; an idle slot burns its deposit, a ripple of loss across the attacker's fakes. A hollow identity earns nothing and loses its deposit. Verified slots earn a violet badge. 1,000 fakes burn 50,000 POA for 500 POA of rewards, a 49,500 POA loss. An honest agent pays once and takes its full share.
